title.value: Mark old Gmail emails as read with an agent

introduction.value: A user asked ChatGPT Agent Mode with a Gmail connector to mark emails before a date as read; it was unclear if it finished and the agent's status was inconsistent.

method.value: The user connected Gmail in ChatGPT Agent Mode and asked it to mark every email before a chosen date as read. The agent said it was starting, thought for a while, then returned the usual end-of-response haptic/feedback state without a clear task status; when the user asked it to verify, it repeatedly said the emails were not marked read and that it would try again, even after the user told it to refresh the Gmail connection.

outcome.value: From the thread, the task did not complete in a way the user could confirm, and the status UI stayed ambiguous. A commenter said agent progress is opaque and agents can fail silently, with the only practical checks being to wait or look for a completion email.

notes.value: The main catch is visibility: this report says there was no reliable in-chat progress indicator, so you may need to manually verify in Gmail or wait for a notification.

source_text.body:
Mark old Gmail emails as read with an agent
A user asked ChatGPT Agent Mode with a Gmail connector to mark emails before a date as read; it was unclear if it finished and the agent's status was inconsistent.
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
The user connected Gmail in ChatGPT Agent Mode and asked it to mark every email before a chosen date as read. The agent said it was starting, thought for a while, then returned the usual end-of-response haptic/feedback state without a clear task status; when the user asked it to verify, it repeatedly said the emails were not marked read and that it would try again, even after the user told it to refresh the Gmail connection.
How it went
From the thread, the task did not complete in a way the user could confirm, and the status UI stayed ambiguous. A commenter said agent progress is opaque and agents can fail silently, with the only practical checks being to wait or look for a completion email.
Worth knowing
The main catch is visibility: this report says there was no reliable in-chat progress indicator, so you may need to manually verify in Gmail or wait for a notification.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Using my connected Gmail, find all emails in my inbox received before [date] that are unread and mark them as read. First tell me how many emails match and show me a few examples, then wait for my go-ahead before changing anything. When finished, report the final count marked as read and confirm that no unread emails before [date] remain, or tell me clearly what could not be completed.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPT/comments/1si89ei/how_do_you_know_if_an_agent_is_still_running_if
